payload.title: Make workbook checksums independent of serialization time
payload.description:
As a report consumer, I want identical workbook inputs and publication timestamps to produce identical bytes, so that checksums are reproducible across runtimes and clock boundaries.

Feature: Deterministic workbook serialization

Scenario: Repeated workbook generation crosses a clock boundary
  Given the same stakeholder projection, revision, and generated-at timestamp
  When the workbook is serialized more than once
  Then the XLSX bytes and SHA-256 checksum are identical
  And the embedded creation and modification timestamps equal the supplied generated-at timestamp rather than the serialization clock.
